fields.notes: MIL-STD-1553B is paired with the SAE AS4111 RT Validation Test Plan and AS4112 RT Production Test Plan, maintained by the SAE AS-1A Avionic Networks Subcommittee. The above categories are derived from the standard's mandatory behaviors + Notice 2 + AS 15531.
verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Register access (read/write to all register fields; reserved-bit behavior)
Nominal transfer / transaction across the protocol's operating modes
Error and fault condition detection and handling
fields.industry_validation_plan: SAE AS4111 — RT Validation Test Plan (formerly MIL-HDBK-1553A Section 100, originally MIL-HDBK-1553 Appendix A). Comprehensive design-verification suite for Remote Terminals designed to AS 15531 / MIL-STD-1553B Notice 2.
fields.industry_production_plan: SAE AS4112 — RT Production Test Plan. Simplified subset of AS4111 intended for in-line production testing of Remote Terminals.

extraction_hints: Look for coverage targets, vplan, regression policy.
